what: HOLDOUT LEDGER UNDERCOUNT RISK: a runner job that calls holdout_lock.claim_read with the default ledger writes the claim to its own checkout of comms/research/holdout_reads.jsonl, and the dispatcher's landing payload does not carry that file back, so the read is never counted and the NEXT read of the family is graded on a too-lenient bar (HOLDOUT-DEFLATED-REUSE). Seen on a474-04 (ENTRY read 12; hand-carried in #26298). A crude grep (2026-11-15) lists ~14 claim_read callers not obviously using the out-dir copy pattern (ml_decision_entry, ml_entry_levers, ml_entry_population_test, ml_entry_regime_split, ml_entry_v2, ml_variant_prop_gate, ...); some may be local-only. Audit each; convert runner-run ones to the copy pattern and back-fill any lost claim lines from their holdout_claim.json / verdict.
